reviewed_by: Codex: direct comparison of dated Penn catalogue fields and scan-checked Montgomery register evidence
scope: Nine newly exposed field differences in the forty-object Montgomery/Penn reference cohort. Source claims and physical identities remain unchanged.

entries.rationale: Penn reports height 8 cm and outside diameter 18 cm; the 1913 register reports height 7.2 cm and diameter 17.7 cm. Both measurements remain source-attributed. The evidence does not establish whether the difference reflects measurement convention, rounding, restoration, or another cause.
entries.review_basis: Compared the dated Penn Details-table observation with the Montgomery register row visually checked against the archived scan. No direct remeasurement or documented equivalence between Diameter and Outside Diameter was available.
